title: Read hosted plans
responsibility: Validate committed plans and turn their current designs into catalog planning records.

inputs.name: hubPlanRecord.context
inputs.description: Provides the source entries and reader used to load plan designs. It is required for resolving design files from the hosted source.

inputs.name: hubPlanRecord.plan
inputs.description: Validated plan metadata and contract to convert into a catalog record. Its path, identity, category, title, goal and contract supply the plan fields; designs are read through the context.

examples.title: Read hosted plans
examples.goal: Validate committed plans and turn their current designs into catalog planning records.

contract.responsibility: Validate committed plans and turn their current designs into catalog planning records.

inputs.name: hubPlans.context
inputs.description: Provides source entries and reads for finding and parsing hosted plan files. Only plan.json entries under the supported category directories are considered.

outputs.name: hubPlans
outputs.description: Resolves to schema-validated plans from supported category directories. Each included plan must match its source path and contract hash, and its unitId must be unique.

examples.title: Read hosted plans
examples.goal: Validate committed plans and turn their current designs into catalog planning records.

contract.responsibility: Validate committed plans and turn their current designs into catalog planning records.

outputs.name: hubPlanRecord
outputs.description: Resolves to a catalog record containing the plan fields, design versions, an empty thread list and a contract hash. The latest design supplies the contract when present; lifecycle is draft without a design, review with an unapproved latest design, and approved with a current approval.

examples.title: Read hosted plans
examples.goal: Validate committed plans and turn their current designs into catalog planning records.

errors.name: hubFail
errors.description: Used when a parsed plan path does not match its source entry or category and slug, its contract hash does not match, or unitId values are duplicated.
